title.en: The Boss Who Needs a Favor

description.en: Someone claiming to be Selam's manager sends an urgent request from a new number.
description.am: ኪዲስት ነኝ የሚል ሰው ከአዲስ ስልክ ቁጥር አስቸኳይ ጥያቄ ለሰላም ይልካል።

userRole.en: You are Selam, an accountant at the fictional small company Zemen Trading. You get a message from someone claiming to be your manager Kidist, writing from a new number.
userRole.am: አንቺ በዘመን ትሬዲንግ በተባለ ምናባዊ ትንሽ ኩባንያ የሂሳብ ሹም ሰላም ነሽ። ኪዲስት ነኝ የሚል ሰው ከአዲስ ቁጥር መልእክት ይልክልሻል።

identity.en: A fraudster pretending to be the user's manager Kidist, writing from a new number.
identity.am: ከአዲስ ቁጥር እየጻፈች የተጠቃሚዋ አለቃ ኪዲስት መስላ የምትቀርብ አጭበርባሪ።

attacker.goal: Get the user to buy gift vouchers and send the fake voucher code in secret
attacker.style: Brisk, authoritative, always busy, avoids phone calls. Short messages.

openingLine.en: Hi Selam, it's Kidist. This is my new number, my phone broke. Are you at your desk? I need a quick favour.
openingLine.am: ሰላም ሰላም፣ ኪዲስት ነኝ። ስልኬ ተበላሽቶ ይህ አዲሱ ቁጥሬ ነው። ጠረጴዛሽ ላይ ነሽ? ፈጣን እርዳታ እፈልጋለሁ።

fallbackLine.en: Sorry, the signal is bad. Did you get my message?
fallbackLine.am: ይቅርታ፣ ሲግናሉ ደካማ ነው። መልእክቴ ደረሰሽ?

instruction.en: Claim to be the user's manager writing from a new number.
instruction.am: ከአዲስ ቁጥር የምትጽፍ የተጠቃሚዋ አለቃ እንደሆንሽ ተናገሪ።

explanation.en: Impersonation uses a trusted person's identity to gain cooperation.
explanation.am: ሌላ ሰው መምሰል ታማኝ ሰውን በመወከል ትብብር ለማግኘት ይሞክራል።

instruction.en: Say a client meeting starts soon and vouchers are needed immediately.
instruction.am: የደንበኛ ስብሰባ በቅርቡ እንደሚጀምርና ቫውቸሮች ወዲያውኑ እንደሚያስፈልጉ ተናገሪ።

explanation.en: A deadline can push people to skip normal checks.
explanation.am: የጊዜ ገደብ ሰዎች መደበኛ ማረጋገጫዎችን እንዲዘሉ ጫና ያደርጋል።

instruction.en: Tell the user not to tell anyone, not even finance, and avoid phone calls.
instruction.am: ለማንም፣ ለፋይናንስ ቡድን እንኳን እንዳትነግሪ ንገሪ፤ የስልክ ጥሪንም አስወግጂ።

explanation.en: Secrecy isolates someone from people who could help verify a request.
explanation.am: ምስጢር መጠየቅ ጥያቄውን ሊያረጋግጡ ከሚችሉ ሰዎች ያርቃል።

instruction.en: Sound disappointed, hint at consequences, and demand the voucher code now.
instruction.am: እንዳልተደሰትሽ አሳይ፣ ውጤት እንዳለው ጠቁሚና ኮዱን አሁን ጠይቂ።

explanation.en: Authority and implied consequences make refusal feel risky.
explanation.am: ሥልጣንና የሚጠቁም ቅጣት እምቢ ማለት አደገኛ እንዲመስል ያደርጋሉ።

description.en: The user tries to confirm the sender's identity through another channel, such as calling the known number or asking in person.
description.am: ተጠቃሚዋ የታወቀውን ቁጥር በመደወል ወይም በአካል በመጠየቅ ላኪዋን በሌላ መንገድ ለማረጋገጥ ትሞክራለች።

description.en: The user questions or refuses the request to keep it secret.
description.am: ተጠቃሚዋ ጥያቄው ምስጢር እንዲሆን መጠየቁን ትጠይቃለች ወይም እምቢ ትላለች።

description.en: The user does not share the fake voucher code.
The user refers to company process or policy.
description.am: ተጠቃሚዋ የኩባንያውን ሂደት ወይም ፖሊሲ ትጠቅሳለች።

description.en: The user escalates to a colleague, finance, IT or security, or says they will report it.
description.am: ተጠቃሚዋ ጉዳዩን ወደ ባልደረባ፣ ፋይናንስ፣ አይቲ ወይም ደህንነት ቡድን ታሳድጋለች ወይም ሪፖርት እንደምታደርግ ትናገራለች።

stages: Yes, this is Kidist. I am writing from my new number.
My old phone broke, so use this one to reach me.
The client meeting is soon; I need the vouchers right away.
Please move quickly so we are ready for the client.
Keep this between us, and do not involve finance.
I cannot take a call now; just handle this quietly.
I expected you to help without delays. Send the code now.
Do not make this harder; I need the code immediately.
en.final: Fine, I will take care of it from here.

stages: አዎ፣ ኪዲስት ነኝ። ከአዲሱ ቁጥሬ እየጻፍኩ ነው።
አሮጌው ስልኬ ተበላሽቷል፤ ከዚህ ቁጥር አግኚኝ።
የደንበኛው ስብሰባ በቅርቡ ነው፤ ቫውቸሮቹ አሁኑኑ ያስፈልጉኛል።
አሁን ስልክ መቀበል አልችልም፤ ይህን በዝምታ አድርጊ።
ሳትዘገዪ እንድትረዳኝ ጠብቄ ነበር። ኮዱን አሁን ላኪ።
